EC1: - Signs or symptoms of cervical radiculopathy, [OR] radiculitis, [OR] or referral from the cervical spine
EC2: - Clinical evidence as determined in the examination of an alternative shoulder diagnosis
EC3: - Normal passive shoulder range of motion
EC4: - Known radiographic evidence of glenohumeral osteoarthritis
EC6: - Received dry needling [OR] or acupuncture within the past 6 months
EC8: - Currently being treated with anticoagulant medication
EC9: - Shoulder pain and disability index (SPADI) score less than 10% [OR] or greater than 90%
